declarations.type:
∀ (left right : SearchLoopMerge.Outcome),
  SearchLoopMerge.joinOutcome left right = SearchLoopMerge.joinOutcome right left
declarations.name: SearchLoopMerge.joinOutcome_commutative

declarations.type:
∀ (first second third : SearchLoopMerge.Outcome),
  SearchLoopMerge.joinOutcome (SearchLoopMerge.joinOutcome first second) third =
    SearchLoopMerge.joinOutcome first (SearchLoopMerge.joinOutcome second third)
declarations.name: SearchLoopMerge.joinOutcome_associative

declarations.type:
∀ {domain : SearchLoopClauseFirst.ValidationDomain} (ledger : SearchLoopMerge.NormalizedLedger domain)
  (left right : SearchLoopMerge.AdmittedResult domain),
  SearchLoopMerge.mergeAdmitted (SearchLoopMerge.mergeAdmitted ledger left) right =
    SearchLoopMerge.mergeAdmitted (SearchLoopMerge.mergeAdmitted ledger right) left
declarations.name: SearchLoopMerge.admitted_merges_commute

declarations.type:
∀ {domain : SearchLoopClauseFirst.ValidationDomain} (ledger : SearchLoopMerge.NormalizedLedger domain)
  (result : SearchLoopMerge.AdmittedResult domain),
  SearchLoopMerge.mergeAdmitted (SearchLoopMerge.mergeAdmitted ledger result) result =
    SearchLoopMerge.mergeAdmitted ledger result
declarations.name: SearchLoopMerge.admitted_merge_is_idempotent

declarations.type:
∀ {domain : SearchLoopClauseFirst.ValidationDomain} (ledger : SearchLoopMerge.NormalizedLedger domain)
  {left right : List (SearchLoopMerge.AdmittedResult domain)},
  left.Perm right → SearchLoopMerge.mergeMany ledger left = SearchLoopMerge.mergeMany ledger right
declarations.name: SearchLoopMerge.mergeMany_permutation_invariant

declarations.type:
∀ (store : SearchLoopMerge.ResultStore) (left right : SearchLoopMerge.ClauseResult),
  left.clause ≠ right.clause →
    SearchLoopMerge.writeResult (SearchLoopMerge.writeResult store left) right =
      SearchLoopMerge.writeResult (SearchLoopMerge.writeResult store right) left
declarations.name: SearchLoopMerge.independent_writes_commute

declarations.type:
∀ (left right : SearchLoopMerge.ClauseResult),
  SearchLoopMerge.mergePair left right = SearchLoopMerge.mergePair right left
declarations.name: SearchLoopMerge.mergePair_commutative

declarations.type:
∀ (result : SearchLoopMerge.ClauseResult),
  SearchLoopMerge.mergePair result result = SearchLoopMerge.PairMerge.merged result
declarations.name: SearchLoopMerge.mergePair_idempotent

declarations.type:
∀ (left right : SearchLoopMerge.ClauseResult),
  left.clause = right.clause →
    left.domain ≠ right.domain →
      SearchLoopMerge.mergePair left right =
        SearchLoopMerge.PairMerge.conflict SearchLoopMerge.MergeConflict.validationDomain
declarations.name: SearchLoopMerge.domain_mismatch_is_typed_conflict

declarations.type:
∀ (left right : SearchLoopMerge.ClauseResult),
  left.clause ≠ right.clause →
    SearchLoopMerge.mergePair left right =
      SearchLoopMerge.PairMerge.conflict SearchLoopMerge.MergeConflict.clauseIdentity
declarations.name: SearchLoopMerge.clause_mismatch_is_typed_conflict

declarations.type:
SearchLoopMerge.writeResult (SearchLoopMerge.writeResult SearchLoopMerge.emptyStore SearchLoopMerge.pendingResult)
    SearchLoopMerge.contradictoryResult ≠
  SearchLoopMerge.writeResult
    (SearchLoopMerge.writeResult SearchLoopMerge.emptyStore SearchLoopMerge.contradictoryResult)
    SearchLoopMerge.pendingResult
declarations.name: SearchLoopMerge.last_write_wins_is_order_dependent
